title: Inverse problems for a nonlinear dynamical Schrödinger operator with magnetic potential
summary: We study two inverse problems for a nonlinear dynamical Schrödinger equation with time-dependent magnetic and electric potentials. Under suitable analyticity assumptions, we show that the associated Dirichlet-to-Neumann map uniquely determines the linear magnetic potential and all coefficients of the nonlinear electric potential. We establish both full-data and partial-data uniqueness results.
